---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an enhancement for the project
title: '[ENHANCEMENT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Objective
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please provide a clear and concise description of the objective.

Example: "I frequently organize screenshots and find it tedious to manually group them by date. An automatic date-based grouping would save time."

## Proposed Solution
Provide a detailed description of the functionality you wish to see implemented.

**Describe the feature:**
- What would it do?
- How would users interact with it?
- Where in the UI would it appear?

## User Impact
Who would benefit from this feature and how?

- **Primary users:** [e.g., Photographers, Developers, general users]
- **Use cases:** [specific scenarios where this helps]
- **Frequency:** [how often would this be used?]

## Technical Considerations
If you have thoughts on implementation:

**AI Integration:**
- Would this require AI provider changes?
- Which AI capabilities would be needed (vision, text analysis, etc.)?

**UI Changes:**
- New views or modifications to existing ones?
- Settings or preferences needed?

**Data/Storage:**
- New data models required?
- Impact on existing organization history?

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

**What have you tried:**
- Current workarounds
- Other apps that solve this problem
- Manual processes

**Why those don't work:**
- Limitations of current approaches

## Rationale
Why should this feature be prioritized?

- **User benefit:** [quantify if possible]
- **Consistency:** [does it align with existing features?]
- **Competitive advantage:** [unique value?]

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples:

- Screenshots from other apps
- Sample file structures
- API documentation links
- Related issues or discussions

## Implementation Ideas
If you are interested in contributing this feature:

- [ ] I would be willing to implement this
- [ ] I can provide UI mockups
- [ ] I can help with testing
- [ ] I need guidance on architecture
